text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's the final straight!!
Who will claim victory in this clash of the century?!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Gooooo-!!" "Do your best!!!"
"You can win this!!" "Gooooooo!!!!"
"Win it, Loves-chaaaan!!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!!!
Winning the race of the century is—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh~~~~!!!
That race was absolutely insane...!
I'm so, so glad I got to see it live~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Loves Only You was amazing too!
I seriously thought she had a real shot at winning...!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, *hic*... Loves-chan...
That was so close...!
But really... you've grown into someone amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu,
the hype on the fan community is totally crazy...!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"That was amazing!!" "So close ;;;;"
"Can't stop crying" "You looked so insanely cool!!"
"So proud" "Great job!" "888888"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I lost, huh.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Still, somehow I feel refreshed.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Surely... because the feeling of running connected to everyone is truly right here――)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLoves-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ai-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Good work.
Your run was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...To the point where it still stings with regret, even now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ai-san is... frustrated...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Today, I intended to show this era what true supremacy is
with a flawless run.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Your running... made me tremble.
Because it held a strength I never knew,
a strength I didn't have...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So that's what your love is...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Until I've completely surpassed yours,
I can't say I've truly become the strongest.
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Please run with me again.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Y-You mean—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That means my long break is officially cancelled! Next time, I will completely triumph over your love!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san.
Thank you so much—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: For acknowledging my love—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...Thank you for staying stronger than anyone else, Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――...A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: “—And so, we decided to just take the rest of the day off, drinking tea and taking it easy~♪”

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Chill vibes are nice~" "Tough race, gg!"
"Still, thx for the stream!" "Yuru-love~"
"Thanks for your hard work today!" "*hands tea*"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"‘Thanks for streaming anyway.’
Fufu♪ As if I wouldn't stream!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because my connection with everyone
is something that could never, ever be missing! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So……
Please keep loving me forever and ever, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna send lo~ts and lots
of love to everyone too!"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Support with love!" "Help with love~!" "So precious"
"Cherish the bond" "Supporting for life!" "Comrades!"
"Everyone in the comm is family" "So lovely~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The bond between Loves Only You and the commu-members
will continue to remain strong from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as long as that bond exists,
she will be able to make her love shine endlessly.
Even reaching a world that no one has ever known—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-kun! Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-chan! Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Look, comments are coming in from everyone!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you as always, Bridge-san!"
"We're counting on you!" "I'm so glad it was you."
"You better make her happy, alright?! ;;;;"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for all your hard work!"
"Thank you for connecting us with Loves-chan!"
"Sending love to our bridge too!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Fufu♪ You're so loved, aren't you♡"
choice_data_list: ...I'll keep returning this love, now and always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Loves Only You's Trainer.
As the bridge connecting her and her community members.
I will continue to devote myself to her and the commu-members.
choice_data_list: —Because that's the love that only I can give.
—Because that's the love that only I can give.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
“Praise Kakeru~!” “That's our girl!”
“Look how much you've grown!” *heart throb*
“That's our Trainer!” “Love has arrived!!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Aah—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I really am so blessed.
